headline: IMF Cites Significant Progress in Türkiye's Fiscal Transparency
summary: Türkiye has made significant progress in fiscal transparency over the past decade, placing it among leading assessed countries according to an IMF report.
why: Fiscal transparency is a critical metric for international investors and rating agencies evaluating sovereign credit risk and macroeconomic policy credibility.

impacts.name: Türkiye
impacts.why: Improved fiscal transparency can enhance investor confidence and lower the sovereign risk premium over time.
